latest.title: Minimum $b_2$ of symplectic fillings of lens spaces
latest.abstract: We classify lens spaces for which the canonical negative-definite plumbing has minimal $b_2$ among all symplectic fillings of the standard contact structure. The classification is given by 4 infinite families of "forbidden subgraphs" in a manner similar to Aceto-McCoy-Park's work on smooth negative-definite fillings of lens spaces. In particular, no classification of this form can be given using a finite list of forbidden configurations, highlighting a difference between symplectic fillings and smooth negative-definite fillings of lens spaces.
latest.topic: 几何拓扑、低维流形与结
latest.workSummary: 分类标准接触透镜空间中典范负定 plumbing 在所有辛填充里具有最小第二 Betti 数的情形，用四个无穷禁子图族刻画。
latest.breakthrough: 表明辛填充的该分类不能压缩为有限禁配置，明确其与光滑负定填充的差别。
latest.limitations: 限于透镜空间及标准接触结构，并非任意接触三流形的填充分类；本轮按摘要核查。
latest.priorityReason: 低维辛拓扑中的明确分类与反有限性结论，面向填充问题读者优先于一般工具，但适用对象较专门。
